## FBT SLAs and the TikTok Shop Fulfillment Policy: Rules, Penalties, and Returns


Fulfillment performance affects the customer experience and your shop’s standing, whether TikTok handles the order or your team does. FBT has service expectations for processing and delivery, while sellers who ship orders themselves must meet TikTok Shop’s dispatch and shipping requirements. TikTok Shop Seller Center is the authority for current thresholds, policy definitions, and account-specific notices. Check it regularly because requirements and enforcement can change, and an older help article may not reflect the rules currently applied to your shop.


### FBT SLA Thresholds: Shipping Speed, On-Time Delivery, and Cancellation Rates


FBT shifts fulfillment operations to TikTok’s service, but sellers still need to monitor inventory accuracy, order status, and account notifications. TikTok promotes 24-hour processing and free three-day delivery on eligible items. These stated service features do not remove the need to watch for exceptions, such as unavailable stock or delayed inbound receiving. Review the SLA metrics shown for your account and act quickly when an order or inventory status signals a problem.


Performance area What to monitor Seller action


Processing Order status and processing time shown in Seller Center Keep sellable inventory available and investigate stalled orders.


Delivery On-time delivery performance and carrier updates Review exceptions and respond to shipment issues promptly.


Cancellations Seller-fault cancellations and inventory discrepancies Reconcile stock and correct inaccurate listing quantities.


### TikTok Shop Fulfillment Policy for Self-Fulfillers: Shipping Windows and Late Dispatch Penalties


With self-fulfillment, you are responsible for preparing orders, handing them to the carrier within the required window, and keeping tracking information accurate. Read the shipping deadline and handling-time rules displayed in Seller Center rather than relying on a schedule from another shop or an old policy summary. Dispatch scans matter: printing a label does not necessarily show that the parcel entered the carrier network. Build enough time for picking, packing, and carrier pickup, including weekends or high-volume sale periods where applicable.


### How Late Dispatch and Seller-Fault Cancellations Impact Account Health and Visibility


Late dispatch and seller-attributed cancellations can signal that an operation is not meeting its service commitments. Repeated failures may prompt account-level consequences under TikTok Shop policy, and poor order experiences can weaken customer confidence. The enforcement response depends on current rules and the facts of each case, so do not assume one penalty applies to every incident. Track late-shipment alerts, cancellation reasons, and inventory mismatches together. Correct the cause and document the steps your team took to prevent another failure.


### FBT Returns Handling


For FBT orders, check Seller Center for the return status, reason, and instructions tied to each case. Follow the displayed process for returned inventory and review whether an item is eligible to return to sellable stock. Do not count returned units as available until their status supports that decision. For self-fulfilled orders, your team must follow TikTok Shop’s return and refund requirements, meet response deadlines, and keep records of the parcel and customer communication. Clear procedures help prevent a return from creating another inventory or service issue.
